{{Top|leg}}
An '''override cutout''' was a part of the internal weapon systems of a typical [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. By engaging the cutout, a starship operator could temporarily deactivate the ship's weapons. This might be done for several reasons: as terms of surrender after a battle, as compliance with safety procedures, or as a condition to gain permission to enter systems or planet where starship weapons were forbidden, such as [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="SH ">[[Scavenger Hunt (adventure)|''Scavenger Hunt'']]</ref>

The [[Ugor/Legends|Ugors]] of the [[Paradise system/Legends|Paradise system]] personally engaged the override cutouts of any foreign ship to visit their territory. The Ugor customs inspector placed a [[customs seal]] over the cutouts to prevent them from being disabled without permission. According to Ugorian law, trying to deactivate these seals was punishable with death. The seals themselves were programmed to explode should they be tampered with.<ref name="SH " />
